Game server: FeedingFranzeeAPI · November 2026

The game portfolio: how every game works, pays and looks

There are six live games. Three are crash games: a multiplier climbs until a random crash, and you cash out or settle before it hits. Two are instant games: the server decides the prize the moment you buy, and the screen reveals it. One is a table game, European roulette on a 3D wheel. One game server decides every outcome and moves every rand through the player's wallet. The game screens only display results.

Each chapter below has real screenshots, the full rules and payout maths, and a small playable demo that uses the game's actual odds and formulas with play money. The demos run entirely in this page and never touch a wallet or the game server.

Chapter 1 · Crash · trading

TradeX

Branded in-game as Margin Call. A crash game dressed as a professional trading terminal. You bet on the direction a market's price moves before the round crashes.

16 marketsmultipliers 1× 2× 5× 10×up to 20 positions / roundloss capped at stakeRTP 96–97%

How a round plays

NEXT ROUND4.2 s
TRADING OPENplace positions · 4.2 – 32.8 s
LAST CALL2.4 s
CRASHED~1.8 s
RESULTS5.4 s

  1. Pick a market

    Forex, crypto, indices or commodities. Your position tracks that market's price.

  2. Choose a direction

    BUY / LONG profits if the price rises. SELL / SHORT profits if it falls.

  3. Stake and multiplier

    Stake R1–R10,000 (quick picks 100 / 250 / 500 / 1K / 5K / Max). The multiplier (1×, 2×, 5× or 10×) scales profit and loss.

  4. Wait for the crash

    There's no cash-out. At the crash every market freezes and each position settles at its own market's frozen price.

How a position pays

BUY   entry = ask (mid + 0.05%)   exit = bid at crash (mid − 0.05%)
SELL  entry = bid (mid − 0.05%)   exit = ask at crash (mid + 0.05%)

P/L    = stake × multiplier × (price move from entry to exit)   // never worse than −stake
return = stake + P/L − 3% commission                           // never below R0, rounded down to the cent

The climbing multiplier doesn't pay out

It only sets how long the round lasts. The crash point is drawn between 1.25× and 14×, giving about 6.6–35 s of live play. Your payout comes entirely from how far the price moved, and in which direction. A 1.3× round can pay well, and a 10× round can still lose.

Chapter 2 · Crash · skill layer

Feeding Frenzy

An underwater crash game. Your bet is a fish that grows as the multiplier climbs. Cash out before a bigger predator eats it, and eat smaller fish along the way to boost your payout.

2 bet slotsauto cash-out from 1.01×boost cap +2.00×house edge 4%provably fair

How a round plays

  1. Place bets (5 s)

    Set an amount in one or both slots and tap FEED during the countdown. Bets can't be cancelled once placed.

  2. Launch

    The multiplier climbs from 1.00×: 2× at ~11.6 s, 5× at ~27 s, 10× at ~38 s, 25× at ~54 s.

  3. Steer and eat

    Hold and drag to swim. Eat smaller fish for a boost and avoid the mines.

  4. Cash out

    Bank stake × (multiplier + boost) on each slot any time before the crash. Anything still riding at the crash is lost.

Your fish grows with the multiplier

  • Example: R100 bet, two grouper eaten (+0.24×), cashed out at 3.10× → R100 × 3.34 = R334.
  • The fish and mine layout comes from the round's public seed, and the server checks every "eat" and "mine hit" against it.

Chapter 4 · Instant · pick

Message in a Bottle

A sunset-beach instant game. Send the tide, five bottles wash ashore, and the message inside the one you open shows your prize.

stakes R2 · R5 · R10 · R20top prize 500×RTP 95.00%any return 55.4%≥ stake back 35.4%

How it plays

  1. Choose a stake

    R2, R5, R10 or R20.

  2. Send the tide

    The server takes the stake, draws the prize, pays any win and sends back the bottles.

  3. Pick a bottle

    Tap one of five, or Quick Pick. Its message shows the prize as a multiple of the stake.

  4. See the rest

    The other four bottles open one by one. Big prizes trigger a celebration banner.

The pick doesn't change the result

The prize is drawn at "Send the tide", before you choose. Whichever bottle you open holds that prize. The other four are filled for display, so picking is part of the show, not a decision.

Chapter 5 · Instant · scratch

Mystery Box

A scratch card with six wrapped boxes. Cash adds up, silver boxes multiply it, a gift box gives a free card, and a golden box unlocks the Golden Vault bonus.

card R5buy 1 · 3 · 5 · 10 cardstop prize 1,000×RTP 94.67%any return 35.7%

The boxes

BoxWhat it does
CashA cash amount, in steps of R2.50. All cash boxes add together.
Silver ×2 ×3 ×5 ×10Multiplies the cash total. Several silvers add together: ×2 + ×3 = ×5. A silver with no cash pays nothing.
GiftA free card: the R5 comes back.
GoldenOpens the Golden Vault: pick one of three vaults worth 20×–1,000× (R100–R5,000). The other two are shown afterwards.
EmptyNothing.
 
win = cash total × (sum of silver multipliers, or ×1 if none)
    = R5            if the card has a gift box
    = vault prize   if the card has a golden box (prizes of 20× and up)

Like the bottles, the result is fixed at purchase

The server draws the prize, then lays out six boxes that add up to exactly that prize. Losing cards are random, not built as near misses. In the vault, the one you pick always holds the drawn prize.

Chapter 6 · Table · on demand

European Roulette

Single-zero roulette on a physics-driven 3D wheel. There are no shared rounds: place chips on the table, press Spin, and the wheel spins just for you and lands on the number the server drew.

37 pockets (0–36)total stake R1 – R10,000 / spinmax win R500,000RTP 97.30% on every betprovably fair

How a spin plays

  1. Pick a chip: 1, 5, 10, 25, 100 or 500 (keys 1–6).
  2. Place bets by clicking the table: numbers, lines between numbers (splits), corners, streets, the outside boxes, or a call bet. Right-click a chip to remove one.
  3. Spin (button or Space). The server checks every bet, debits the total once, draws the number, credits the win and returns the result.
  4. The wheel lands on that number. Winning bets pay amount × (odds + 1). Pressing Spin straight after a result replays the same bets.

The physics is real, but the result is decided first

The number is drawn by the server's provably fair RNG before the ball is launched. A background worker then pre-simulates launch speeds so the physics engine's ball comes to rest in that pocket. The ball's path is genuine physics, but it's steered to a result that was already fixed.

Every bet on the table

BetCoversPaysChanceMax per position
Straight up1 number (incl. 0)35 : 12.70%R100
Split2 adjacent numbers17 : 15.41%R200
Streeta row of 311 : 18.11%R300
Trio0-1-2 or 0-2-311 : 18.11%R300

Red / Black, Odd / Even, 1–18 / 19–3618 numbers1 : 148.65%R3,000
  • The house edge is 2.70% on every bet (1 in 37, from the single zero). For example, a straight up returns 36 × 1/37 = 97.30%. Zero loses all outside bets, and there's no "la partage" or "en prison" rule.
  • Total stake per spin must be R1–R10,000, with at most 150 bets per spin. Total win per spin is capped at R500,000.
  • The server only accepts real table positions. A "split" on 1 and 36, for example, is rejected.

Notes for operators

Shared crash engine (Feeding Frenzy, Comet Rider)

  • Crash points have a 4% house edge and a 10,000× ceiling. The chance of reaching target x is about 96% ÷ x: ~48% for 2×, ~9.6% for 10×. About 4% of rounds crash instantly at 1.00×.
  • Provably fair: the SHA-256 hash of the server seed is published before betting opens, and the seed is revealed after the crash.
  • Boosts are added in full on top of the cash-out multiplier, up to +2.00× per bet, even on early cash-outs. A player who collects lots of boost and cashes out early can push their return above 96%, while mines and asteroids pull it back down. Track realised RTP per game.
  • Every eat and mine/asteroid hit is checked on the server against the deterministic spawn schedule, the player's size and the timing.
  • The engine also supports a 50/50 double-or-nothing gamble on winnings, but neither game screen shows it.

Shared platform

  • Every game launches from the lobby with a session token (/?token=…) and plays against the player's real wallet.
  • Stakes are debited before play. If a debit succeeds but the bet can't be placed, it's rolled back automatically.
  • If the wallet is unreachable when paying a win, the win is recorded and retried. The player sees a "payout delayed" notice.
  • TradeX house edge = 3% commission + 10 bps spread (measured RTP 96–97%), configured under MarginCall.
  • Roulette (Engine: Roulette) uses a 37-pocket wheel RNG. Per-position limits and the 150-bets-per-spin cap live in the game's Roulette block. Wins are capped at MaxWin per spin.
  • Limits, prize tables and odds live in appsettings.json (Games, GameConfig, MarginCall). The RTP figures in this guide are calculated from the current tables.
